_readme: Copy to appsettings.Worker.Production.json, replace every <...> value, and pass it to Install-WorkbenchWorker.ps1 -SettingsFile. These are the exact names the worker reads (src/Governance.Worker, Governance.Infrastructure, Governance.Notifications). No secrets here: Graph, Power Platform and the channel flow use the worker certificate found by subject (LocalMachine\My is searched after CurrentUser\My), SQL uses Windows authentication as the worker gMSA. The ITSM password and the channel flow URL carry secrets: set them as machine environment variables for the service account (Itsm__Password, Notifications__ChannelFlowUrl), never in this file (see Deploy-Production.md, step 9).

Tenant.WorkerClientId: <Worker app registration client ID for this environment>
Tenant.TeamsAppId: <Teams app ID from the org catalog>
Tenant.CatalogId: <entitlement management catalog ID of the governed access packages>

Notifications.SmtpHost: <internal SMTP relay host, or empty for no fallback>
